#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only, GPU-hidden grammar mask proof using the existing pinned tokenizer."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

assert os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") == ""
assert os.environ.get("HF_HUB_OFFLINE") == "1"
assert os.environ.get("TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE") == "1"

import torch
import xgrammar as xgr
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
assert importlib.metadata.version("xgrammar") == "0.1.23"
MODEL = Path("/root/batchforge-runtime/models/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct/a09a35458c702b33eeacc393d103063234e8bc28")
PREFIX = '{"translation_zh":"'
COMPLETE = '{"translation_zh":"你好"}'
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
config = json.loads((MODEL / "config.json").read_text())
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(str(MODEL), local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False)
assert tokenizer.eos_token_id == 151645
assert tokenizer.convert_ids_to_tokens(151643) == "<|endoftext|>"

def mask(matcher, vocab_size):
    # Explicit CPU allocation; no CUDA tensors, CUDA discovery, or GPU API calls.
    bits = torch.full((1, (vocab_size + 31) // 32), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device="cpu")
    assert bits.device.type == "cpu"
    needed = matcher.fill_next_token_bitmask(bits)
    return {str(token): bool((int(bits[0, token // 32].item()) >> (token % 32)) & 1)
            for token in (151643, 151645)}, bool(needed)

rows = []
for label, stops in (("hf_default", None), ("explicit_both_eos", [151645, 151643])):
    kwargs = {} if stops is None else {"stop_token_ids": stops}
    info = xgr.TokenizerInfo.from_huggingface(tokenizer, vocab_size=config["vocab_size"], **kwargs)
    compiler = xgr.GrammarCompiler(info, max_threads=1, cache_enabled=False)
    grammar = compiler.compile_builtin_json_grammar()
    row = {"case": label, "effective_stop_token_ids": list(info.stop_token_ids), "vocab_size": info.vocab_size}
    checks = []
    for method in ("accept_string", "accept_tokenized_prefix"):
        matcher = xgr.GrammarMatcher(grammar)
        if method == "accept_string":
            accepted = matcher.accept_string(PREFIX)
        else:
            accepted = all(matcher.accept_token(token) for token in tokenizer.encode(PREFIX, add_special_tokens=False))
        assert accepted
        terminated_before = matcher.is_terminated()
        allowed, needed = mask(matcher, info.vocab_size)
        accepted_extra = matcher.accept_token(151643)
        checks.append({"method": method, "prefix_accepted": accepted,
                       "terminated_after_prefix": terminated_before, "mask_required": needed,
                       "allowed_next_token": allowed, "accept_151643": accepted_extra,
                       "terminated_after_151643_attempt": matcher.is_terminated()})
        assert not terminated_before
        assert not allowed["151645"]
        assert allowed["151643"] == (stops is None)
        assert accepted_extra == (stops is None)
        assert not matcher.is_terminated()
    control = xgr.GrammarMatcher(grammar)
    assert control.accept_string(COMPLETE)
    control_mask, _ = mask(control, info.vocab_size)
    assert control_mask["151645"]
    assert control.accept_token(151645)
    assert control.is_terminated()
    row.update(prefix_checks=checks, completed_json_control={"allowed_next_token": control_mask,
               "accept_151645": True, "terminated_after_151645": True})
    rows.append(row)

assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
report = {"status": "passed", "started_at": started,
          "finished_at": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          "cpu_only": {"cuda_visible_devices": os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"],
                       "explicit_tensor_device": "cpu", "cuda_initialized_before": False,
                       "cuda_initialized_after": torch.cuda.is_initialized(),
                       "gpu_discovery_or_inference_called": False},
          "versions": {name: importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in ("torch", "transformers", "xgrammar")},
          "model_revision": MODEL.name,
          "tokenizer_eos_token_id": tokenizer.eos_token_id,
          "probe_token_id": 151643, "probe_token_text": tokenizer.convert_ids_to_tokens(151643),
          "synthetic_prefix": PREFIX, "complete_control": COMPLETE,
          "prefix_token_ids": tokenizer.encode(PREFIX, add_special_tokens=False),
          "local_config_sha256": {name: hashlib.sha256((MODEL / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                                   for name in ("config.json", "tokenizer_config.json", "generation_config.json")},
          "cases": rows,
          "measurement_bounds": "Synthetic CPU grammar-state proof only; no captured model prefix replay, GPU inference, service changes, or whole-workload attribution."}
print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
